uncovered_shapes.sentence: A vote-share contract pays according to the share of the popular vote, so the price is a forecast of the margin, not of the winner.

claims.claim: On October 27, 2026 the CFTC announced a lawsuit against Utah to block state efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets.
claims.episode_span: On October 27 the Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced its tenth state lawsuit
claims.source_title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
claims.supporting_quote: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws.

claims.claim: The Utah case is the tenth state in which federal regulators have sued to assert jurisdiction over prediction markets.
claims.episode_span: announced its tenth state lawsuit
claims.source_title: CFTC and DOJ sue Utah in bid to shield Kalshi from state gambling crackdown
claims.supporting_quote: Utah is the tenth state where federal regulators have intervened to assert jurisdiction over registered exchanges in prediction market disputes

claims.claim: The federal suit names Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown and seeks preliminary and permanent injunctions.
claims.episode_span: against the state and Attorney General Derek Brown, seeking injunctions
claims.source_title: CFTC and DOJ sue Utah in bid to shield Kalshi from state gambling crackdown
claims.supporting_quote: The suit, filed in the United States District Court for the District of Utah, names the State of Utah and Attorney General Derek Brown as defendants.

claims.claim: Utah sued Kalshi on October 20 seeking fee recovery described as between 30.6 million and 61.2 million dollars.
claims.episode_span: Utah's complaint seeks fee recovery it puts between 30.6 million and 61.2 million dollars
claims.source_title: CFTC and DOJ sue Utah in bid to shield Kalshi from state gambling crackdown
claims.supporting_quote: The federal case follows Brown’s own lawsuit of October 20, which targeted multiple Kalshi entities and seeks to halt the exchange’s operations in the state while recovering fees the state’s complaint puts at between US$30.6 million and US$61.2 million.

claims.claim: Utah alleges residents suffered about 5.5 million dollars in trading losses.
claims.episode_span: alleges about 5.5 million dollars in resident trading losses
claims.source_title: CFTC Sues Utah, Warns Kalshi Crackdown Threatens Federal Oversight
claims.supporting_quote: The state also alleges residents suffered approximately $5.5 million in trading losses.

claims.claim: On August 4, 2026 Judge Robert J. Shelby ruled federal commodities law did not preempt Utah gambling law as applied to Kalshi sports contracts.
claims.episode_span: On August 4, 2026, U.S. District Judge Robert J. Shelby ruled that the Commodity Exchange Act does not preempt Utah's gambling laws
claims.source_title: CFTC Sues Utah, Warns Kalshi Crackdown Threatens Federal Oversight
claims.supporting_quote: On Aug. 4, U.S. District Judge Robert J. Shelby ruled that federal commodities law didn’t prevent Utah from enforcing its gambling prohibitions against Kalshi’s sports contracts.

claims.claim: The Tenth Circuit denied Kalshi an injunction pending appeal on September 8.
claims.episode_span: on September 8 the Tenth Circuit denied an injunction pending appeal
claims.source_title: CFTC Sues Utah, Warns Kalshi Crackdown Threatens Federal Oversight
claims.supporting_quote: the 10th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals denied its request for an injunction pending appeal on Sept. 8.

claims.claim: Derek Brown said offering gambling to Utahns is illegal and no Utah law authorizes it.
claims.episode_span: anyone offering gambling to Utahns is on notice that it is illegal and that no Utah law authorizes it
claims.source_title: CFTC and DOJ sue Utah in bid to shield Kalshi from state gambling crackdown
claims.supporting_quote: Anyone offering gambling to Utahns is on notice that it is illegal in Utah and that no Utah law authorizes it.

claims.claim: Jacki McGavick said no single state should have a veto over Kalshi.
claims.episode_span: no single state should have a veto over it
claims.source_title: CFTC Sues Utah Over Prediction Market Regulation Dispute
claims.supporting_quote: As a national derivatives market overseen by the CFTC, Kalshi answers to federal law, and no single state should have a veto over it.

claims.claim: The CFTC plans to publish the Commitments of Traders report twice a week by the end of 2026.
claims.episode_span: publish the Commitments of Traders report twice a week by the end of 2026
claims.source_title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
claims.supporting_quote: CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026.

claims.claim: On September 29 the Iowa Electronic Markets thinly traded vote-share market forecast a 9-point Democratic popular-vote margin and the thick winner-takes-all market an 85.7 percent chance.
claims.episode_span: it priced a 9-percentage-point Democratic popular-vote margin
claims.source_title: Iowa Electronic Markets: Forecasting the 2024 US Presidential Election
claims.supporting_quote: On September 29, the IEM forecast a 9-percentage-point Democratic popular vote margin according to a thinly traded vote-share market and an 85.7% chance the Democrat will receive more votes than the Republican in a thickly traded winner-takes-all market.

claims.claim: A distribution from both IEM markets implied a 6- to 7-point Democratic margin and an 87.0 percent chance of winning.
claims.episode_span: That combined reading was a 6- to 7-percentage-point Democratic margin, and an 87.0 percent chance
claims.source_title: Iowa Electronic Markets: Forecasting the 2024 US Presidential Election
claims.supporting_quote: Using a distribution derived from both markets, the forecasts are for a 6- to 7-percentage-point Democratic margin and 87.0% chance of winning.
